added: Showcase-based public entry, workspace and project navigation, and assessment views.
Survey Share controls create participant links and display locally generated QR codes.
changed: The primary web entry uses the new assessment shell; existing participant, invitation and legacy routes remain available.
Assessment views separate navigation from stage changes and preserve explicit permission scopes.
fixed: Held or refused reports remain visible as honest states, with mobile layout and report-number readability improvements.
security: Credential-bearing route changes retain the accepted forwarding behavior; no new permission inheritance is introduced.
